text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!!)

Kitasan Black gave it her all and finished 
strong. Running up to her—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Just listen to these 
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kii-taa-saa-n! Kii-taa-saa-n!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've finally arrived. Both my 
skill and popularity are right next to 
where I've been aiming for...!

Taking on the world, Kitasan Black 
splendidly fulfilled her role as Japan's 
General of Good Deeds.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan...! Kita-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Dia-chan! Were you watching?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course. Um... I noticed during 
the race, but could it be...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Didn't she throw a shoe? I thought I saw a 
horseshoe fly off midway through...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... You noticed? Something felt a 
little off midway through. But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Races are full of unexpected things. I'm 
not going to panic over a little trouble 
anymore!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what happens, I'll see it 
through to the end!"

Peak dependability right here. And so, the 
preparations for the year-end showdown are 
finally complete.

That night—the two were at the place 
filled with memories. The place where they 
had first pledged to 'run together.'

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally time, Dia-chan... The moment 
we've always dreamed of..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, running the Arima Kinen together. 
The place we've been aiming for, hand in 
hand just like sisters...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sisters, huh. That was always the plan, 
but looking back now... I wonder if I 
really managed to be a good big sister 
figure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Because Dia-chan is...

text_block_list.name: Young Dia
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan! Look, look, I finished building 
the blocks you taught me!

text_block_list.name: Young Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, already? Even though I failed so many 
times, you did it in just one try...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even the things I struggled with, you 
could do right away. You were such an 
honor student.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe Dia-chan would be fine even without 
me..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "No! That's not true, Kita-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was able to do it because you showed me 
the way first, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan has always thrown herself into 
being a role model for me. Even when 
things didn't go well, she showed me that 
this was the way to do it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't a failure. Even if you feel 
that way, Kita-chan, it wasn't "our 
failure."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You in front, and me behind. Because we 
kept going like that, we were able to make 
it this far.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia-chan...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You know, I sometimes think about it... 
whenever I look up at the night sky and 
the flowing Milky Way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've always felt that Kita-chan and I have 
been rowing the same boat down the same 
river, heading toward the exact same 
destination.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The two of us have plenty of differences, 
but deep down in our hearts, we're more 
alike than anyone……

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even if we aren't real sisters, we're more 
like sisters than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Sisters... more than anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You're right. Dia-chan's joys and 
sorrows, I've always felt them as if they 
were my own.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No two people share a bond as strong as 
theirs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. I felt it just as much 
as if it were happening to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sisters more than anyone else, continuing 
to elevate each other towards what lies 
beyond the river...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, Dia-chan! When the real Arima 
Kinen comes, let's enter the gates with 
our hearts as one!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just like when we first passed through the 
gates of Tracen Academy! Vowing that we 
wouldn't lose to each other...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, our hearts as one. Just like we've 
always done. And from here on out, too—

A river of friendship. Yet deep beneath 
its surface— lies a continuous, 
inseparable current.

Even if they part ways once, they will 
inevitably draw near each other again... 
And clashing at the Arima Kinen, they 
become one.
